people.name: Harry A Papp
people.bio_note: Managing Partner & Portfolio Manager; son of founder L. Roy Papp and Marilyn Papp. With the firm since 1981, over four decades in portfolio management. Previously in G.D. Searle & Co.'s Treasurer's Office handling overseas financing and domestic real estate. Holds an AB from Brown University and an MBA (Finance/Accounting) and MS (Geochemistry) from the University of Chicago. Serves on the Arizona State Board of Investment (oversees $11B+ in state investments), is former board chair of Blue Cross/Blue Shield Arizona, vice-chair of the Arizona Public Safety Personnel Retirement System board, and a trustee of the Phoenix Zoo and ASU Foundation.
people.bio_source: roypapp.com/partners.html; independently corroborated by historicalleague.org/historymakers/harry-papp (AZ Historymaker oral history bio) and linkedin.com/in/harry-papp-75875423

people.name: Rosellen C Papp
people.bio_note: Partner & Research Director, CFA charterholder; daughter of founder L. Roy Papp, sister of Harry Papp. Joined the firm in 1981 after moving from Illinois, where she supervised strategic planning in G.D. Searle & Co.'s pharmaceutical group. Manages the Papp Small & Mid-Cap Growth Fund. Holds a BBA from University of Michigan and an MBA from Northwestern's Kellogg School of Management. Serves on the Flinn Foundation board (joined 1998, treasurer 2005, vice chair 2023), is a Phoenix Art Museum trustee, and past director of Ballet Arizona.
people.bio_source: roypapp.com/team.html; independently corroborated by flinn.org/flinn-staff/rosellen-c-papp-c-f-a (Flinn Foundation staff bio) and historicalleague.org/historymakers/rosellen-papp

people.name: Jeffrey Nels Edwards
people.bio_note: Partner & Portfolio Manager, CFA charterholder. Joined L. Roy Papp & Associates in 1987 after starting his career in 1982 as a Trust Investment Officer at FirsTier Bank in Lincoln, Nebraska, trading government, corporate and municipal bonds. Holds an MBA in Finance from the University of Nebraska and a BA in Business Administration from Hastings College; was a 1981 NAIA Track & Field All-American. Serves as a Wharton Foundation trustee.
people.bio_source: roypapp.com/partners.html (firm's own website states his MBA, Hastings College BA, 1981 NAIA All-American honor, and Wharton Foundation trustee role). Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): the previously-cited independent source does not actually contain this detail when checked directly -- corrected to credit the firm's own website, which under current sourcing policy is treated as sufficient on its own. (smartadvisormatch.com/advisor-network/arizona/jeffrey-edwards-1105196 confirms only his CFA credential and current role, not these specific biographical facts.)

people.name: Christopher Lauren Schaefer
people.bio_note: Partner & Senior Portfolio Manager, CFA charterholder. Began his financial career in 1997 and joined L. Roy Papp & Associates as an associate in 2005, after managing portfolios at Wells Fargo Private Client Services; earlier background includes risk analyst/senior auditor work at USAA. Holds a BS in Finance from Arizona State University. Former president and board member of the Phoenix CFA Society; serves on the Florence Crittenton board.

people.name: Brian Michael Riordan
people.bio_note: Partner & Research Analyst, CFA charterholder. Joined L. Roy Papp & Associates in 2004, with financial industry experience dating to 1997. Co-manages the Papp Small & Mid-Cap Growth Fund. Prior roles at Neuberger Berman, Sanford C. Bernstein, and IBM. Holds an MBA from Arizona State University and a BS from Villanova University.
people.bio_source: roypapp.com/team.html (firm website only — a genuine search for independent corroboration on LinkedIn, press, or industry directories did not turn up a specific, matching independent profile for this individual)

firm_note.text: L. Roy Papp & Associates, LLP is a Phoenix investment counseling firm founded in 1977-1979 by L. Roy Papp, a former U.S. director and ambassador to the Asian Development Bank. Now led by his son Harry Papp and daughter Rosellen Papp, the firm manages roughly $1.4-1.6B and is known for the Papp mutual funds. The Papp family is prominent in Phoenix philanthropy (Phoenix Art Museum's Marilyn and L. Roy Papp Family Gallery, arts, education).
